services.title: Steering, suspension and alignment
services.body: Worn steering and suspension parts come off, the replacement goes on beside them, and the alignment is set on the rack afterwards.

evidence.text: JR and his guys replaced control arms, tires and did an alignment on my 2015 Chrysler 300c.

reviews.author: Melissa McVey
reviews.text: Great prices compared to other mechanic shops, they're honest and don't come up with random issues to make more money off of you. I've been there for 2 different more expensive jobs that I couldn't do myself this time around and called around to other shops and they were the best rate for also have good reviews. I'd definitely trust them again.

reviews.author: Andrew Thao
reviews.text: Came in for a new AC compressor and tires mounted. They found it was just a cracked pipe and replaced it instead of the compressor which was a cheaper repair. The tire mounting was not great. All four wheels paint were scratched/chipped along the edges and lug nuts were way over torqued. It was more of a hassle than necessary, but the situation was resolved with Redline covering another shop to repaint the wheels edges.

reviews.author: Renee Martin
reviews.text: Stopped in to Redline one afternoon with no appointment after my car started making funny noises. The owner was nice enough to take the time to drive it and put it on the lift to check it out was told it was my rear differential which could cost 3000 but he took the time to find a used one which cost less than 600. Just picked up my car and it's running great. First time there for me but will definitely go back in the future.

reviews.author: Randy Brooks
reviews.text: I have been a mechanic for 55 years i can no longer do my own repairs these guys fixed my car in a timely manner charged me what they had said it would cost and did not try to sell me anything else.

reviews.author: Mitchell Johnson
reviews.text: I just want to say, I lived almost hours and half from this place and happened to have had a meeting up about half mile from them. I literally walked in and told the folks that greeted me when walking in of my situation. He Informed me they had a lot of cars in process now, but graciously allowed me to leave my keys to replace alternator on the vehicle and said they would try and get it taken care of with the 2 hours I was only in town for this meeting. Man. Let me tell you my car was fixed in under the 2 hours while I was at the meeting and I insisted to pay extra and the Gentleman behind the counter said, No Not necessary, and I kept insisting and he refused to allow me to pay extra for it. The name tag on the Gentlman helping me was JR, I later found out he was the owner. This is literally one of the Very Best experiences I have ever had. Thank you JR, you all are special !

reviews.author: Lloyd Hudson
reviews.text: This is one of the most trustworthy and qualified places in our area. I love this place. I never have to worry about being took advantage of. Very honest.

reviews.author: Kendra Hagler
reviews.text: Most amazing, experienced and ethical mechanic I've met. Not to mention the pricing is very affordable and fair. Don't make the mistake I did and take it to a mechanic that don't care and only wants your money. JR knows what he's doing and you can sleep good knowing he will do the job right.

reviews.author: Chad Penland
reviews.text: Really hard working staff and honestly I'm impressed by how they want to help you the best way can. Thank you All

reviews.author: Lance Smith
reviews.text: I had an issue with a vehicle I just got and was skeptical of who to take it to. After asking around a bit, I had lots of people suggest Redline and with that many people's recommendation I figured there had to be something to it. I called and talked to Jr and he was nothing short of kind, friendly, and helpful. He got me scheduled to bring it in and once I got it in, he checked it out, notified me of the issue, and got me taken care of. With great service and good prices I couldn't have asked for a better experience and they will definitely have my business in the future. Definitely recommend giving them a call if you need vehicle work done and want a fair and honest mechanic!

reviews.author: S Harviroc EL
reviews.text: They took good care of my vehicle. Good job and a great price Also, they are good at what they do, therefore, sometimes they are very busy. Patience pays off with Redline. If you in a rush NOT and low quality matters not to you. Then Redline is a no go. But, if you want quality experience this is the place.

reviews.author: Joan Silvestro
reviews.text: We have dealt with Redline on several occasions. We have always gotten great service for a much better price than any other garage. We are so blessed we found them when we moved to Newton. Very friendly and honest. They do right by their customers. We would recommend them to our children for service.

reviews.author: Lisa Luthi
reviews.text: These guys were so helpful! We needed a last minute pre-buy car inspection and he made time to fit us in the same day we called. He knew the problem areas of the Ford F150 that we brought in but also checked the areas we had concerns about. He was thorough, quick, and explained each problematic item he found in the inspection. If you want quality work and to be treated well, go here!

reviews.author: Jeremy Bean
reviews.text: I'm giving them a two star for the benefit of the doubt. I can only speak from my experience and that experience wasn't very pleasant since my only interaction was over the phone. My car broke down and what was wrong was apparently something that not many mechanics in the area was willing to touch. After calling here to see if they were willing to fix my vehicle (which they were) I was told that they wouldn't even be able to look at my car for over a week. We all know that we rely heavily on our cars and when they need to be repaired we can't afford for them to sit for an extended period of time. After calling around I eventually found someone who was able to get to my car within 24 hours and not 10 days. I would have normally given something like this a one star but due to people I know speaking highly of this place I didn't completely bomb them on the review and hopefully they will figure out whatever has them backed up one day and maybe I can give them another shot to update this review.

reviews.author: Colleen Strong
reviews.text: JR and mechanics are awesome! Had my front brakes worked on and needed a new brake line and caliper. You give the best prices, excellent work and very friendly. I have referred several people to your shop because of the great work you all do. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Ray Ford
reviews.text: They are very trust worthy and their work is top notch. I have been going there since they opened up and I have always got the best service from them. I'm so glad we have them in our community they do make a difference by the outstanding quality of service and work.

reviews.author: Colleen Strong
reviews.text: I took my car to Redline to have my fuel pump replaced, they had it fixed within a few hours not days. I will continue to use Redline for all of my car problems! They are awesome and I recommend them to everyone. Thank you so much for your speedy service.

reviews.author: Andi Martin
reviews.text: Our whole family goes to redline. I will not go anywhere else. JR really wants to help and he is honest . It’s a rare thing these days to have a place you can go and know they do what they say. We love Kendra too very much

reviews.author: Trey Bowman
reviews.text: Best work and friendly people and great prices. They do not try to rip you off. Very truly about there work. Thanks again redline automotive. I do prefer to anyone out there.

reviews.author: Tyronne Smith
reviews.text: Great staff..we have been taking our vehicles to Redline for over 5 years. Their honest friendly fast and I won't take my cars or trucks any where else.

reviews.author: TakingRainbowsBack !
reviews.text: Moved to Newton and got very lucky to find this honest business. Had problems and from what I was getting online it was probably going to be an expensive fix.... When I took my car and dropped it off I told them what I had read and he said yeah if that's what it is, then thats a pretty expensive job.. called me back couple hours later to pick it up. Was just a fuse ... He could have held it a couple days and told me it was the expensive job... I've taken my business there ever since and been just as pleased every time.

reviews.author: Laura Ide
reviews.text: I recommend this place for anyone who wants great work done at a fair price! Have had car worked on there 2 times and gotten all of our inspections there. Anytime I need anything else done I will call them first.

reviews.author: rick frye
reviews.text: Took my wifes car in to have checked out. Several codes showing. Told me what they found. Never charged me for the test. Very nice people.

reviews.author: Lynn Starwalker
reviews.text: YOU GUYS ARE THE BEST ! i just crossed over 350K on the odometer & today was the day for an oil change (i couldn't have made it this far without Junior & his crew at Redline) REDLINE IMPRESSES ME EVERY TIME I VISIT like they say on WNNC: "TAKE IT TO JUNIOR" THANX Kendra THANX Junior THANX CREW ! C-Ya in 10K !

reviews.author: Oletha Rhinehardt
reviews.text: A number 1 experience each time I need their services. The prices are reasonable and the service is efficient. The owner is very knowledgeable and genuinely a nice person.

reviews.author: Tyler Davis
reviews.text: Great, timely service. Reasonably priced. I've used them for years on multiple vehicles and they have always done right by me.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.text: Gave them 2000 dollars (way over priced) to put a motor in my car. Got a 6month warranty. Within that 6 months I have took it back 7 times and still my car wont run and they wont return my calls or nothing so I will be letting the court system handle this one.

reviews.author: Larry Axtell
reviews.text: Great place. The owner is one of the most honest business owners I’ve met. Will not replace something unless it really needs replacement

reviews.author: Suzi Gonzales
reviews.text: Such nice folks! I have only been there for inspection. However, I would trust them if I needed them for other car problems.

reviews.author: S Damron
reviews.text: JR and his guys replaced control arms, tires and did an alignment on my 2015 Chrysler 300c. It rides and handles like it did when it was new. Thank you for keeping me on the road!

reviews.author: Roz
reviews.text: I have used Redline since 2010, they are the only shop I use now because they are reliable and honest, and do top-notch work.

reviews.author: Will Rowe
reviews.text: I’ve used these guys a few times. They always had the best price and they’ve always done a good job.

reviews.author: B McGee
reviews.text: They let me use their canopy to get my windshields replaced during a rainy day. I greatly appreciate them for that. Thank you

reviews.author: Delta Eldreth
reviews.text: Best place to have any automobile repairs or maintenance done. They are wonderful trustworthy people..highly recommend

reviews.author: Edward Thompson
reviews.text: Stays busy all the time why? Because Junior and his team are the best! Honest caring go the extra mile to help!

reviews.author: Krystal Brookins
reviews.text: JR is very honest, I've learned this first hand through other customers! I will never go anywhere else!!!

reviews.author: Jonathan Miller
reviews.text: Junior and the gang are super! I went in for an inspection, got it and skiddade-elled in no time. Yeehaw! Here we're go!

reviews.author: mike murphy
reviews.text: Great place!!!! Jr is the best and his staff are knowledge able and friendly. They almost compare to Jump automotive.

reviews.author: STEVE-O
reviews.text: THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE I HAVE MY VEHICLES WORKED ON. JR IS AN AWESOME MECHANIC AND VERY TRUSTWORTHY YOUR GONNA REGRET TAKING YOUR VEHICLES ELSEWHERE

reviews.author: Bobby Ballard
reviews.text: Replaced my starter, quickly and at a reasonable price. Look forward to doing service with them in the future.
